title: Free JuCo Soccer: LACC vs. El Camino
description: Skip the $200 pro tickets and catch genuine soccer at LACC Athletic Field & Gym. LACC vs. El Camino is free and delivers real energy.

title: Soccer at Mt. SAC: Mt. SAC vs. Mt. SAC
description: At Mt. SAC's world-class Hilmer Lodge Stadium, Mt. SAC hosts Mt. SAC for soccer. The setting alone makes this worth the trip — and admission is free.

title: Free JuCo Basketball: Rio Hondo vs. Long Beach
description: Want competitive basketball without spending a dime? Rio Hondo takes on Long Beach at Rio Hondo College Athletic Complex. Free admission — just show up.

title: Chargers vs. Denver Broncos
description: SoFi Stadium plays host as the Chargers take on the Denver Broncos this Sunday. Circle this one on the calendar.

title: Western Conference Clash: Lakers vs. Denver Nuggets
description: A playoff-caliber matchup with real stakes. The Denver Nuggets come to Crypto.com Arena for a Saturday showdown. This is appointment viewing.

title: Rams vs. Arizona Cardinals
description: The Arizona Cardinals come to town for a Sunday clash at SoFi Stadium. The Rams are looking to put on a show for the home crowd.
